what: JC-SA-08 population is too small to decide (a) caveat vs (b) mirror-follows-venue: since the strict Stage-2 roster (2026-09-21) there are 3 alpaca_live closes and only 1 has an alpaca_portfolio twin (SLV 5875/5874). That one diverged: the same-level GTC OCO stop filled live at 13:30:03 @55.3132 and on the paper mirror at 13:35:06 @55.38189 (+12.4 bps, mirror better; alpaca_paper +14.8 bps). Mechanism: paper-engine fill vs live venue fill on an opening gap, not an app-side exit and not the re-arm window. Data task: extend to every Alpaca stop/target exit since 2026-09-01 where a live account and any paper book held the same strategy x symbol (roster strictness does not affect the mechanism), and report n, the sign distribution and mean gap in bps. The (a)/(b) decision waits on it.
